_note: Fighter (2024). Base class + Champion are SRD 5.2 (CC-BY); Battle Master / Eldritch Knight / Psi Warrior are mechanics + original descriptions.

classes.name: Fighter
startingEquipment: Chain Mail, Greatsword, Flail, 8 Javelins, Dungeoneer's Pack, 4 GP
or Studded Leather, Scimitar, Shortsword, Longbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Dungeoneer's Pack, 11 GP
classes.flavor: A master of weapons and armor whose training turns any fight to advantage — striking more often than anyone, surging into extra action, and shrugging off what should have stopped them.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (such as Archery, Defense, Great Weapon Fighting, or Two-Weapon Fighting).

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: As a Bonus Action you regain 1d10 + your Fighter level HP. You have a number of uses shown on the table and regain one on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You can use the Mastery property of a number of weapon kinds shown on the table (3 at level 1), provided you're proficient. You can change your choices after a Long Rest.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: On your turn you can take one additional action (any except casting a spell). Once per Short or Long Rest (twice at level 17).

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.description: When you fail an ability check, you can spend a use of Second Wind (without regaining HP) to add 1d10 to the check, potentially turning the failure into a success.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two by 1 (max 20), or take a feat. Repeats at 6th, 8th, 12th, 14th, and 16th level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice whenever you take the Attack action (three times at level 11, four times at level 20).

features.name: Tactical Shift
features.description: When you activate Second Wind you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: You can reroll a saving throw you fail and must use the new roll. You gain a use back on a Long Rest (two uses at 13th, three at 17th level).

features.name: Tactical Master
features.description: When you attack with a weapon whose Mastery you can use, you can replace that property with the Push, Sap, or Slow mastery for that attack.

features.name: Studied Attacks
features.description: If you miss a creature with an attack, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against it before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Combat Prowess is a fitting choice.

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.flavor: A paragon of physical excellence who lands more critical hits, excels at athletic feats, and refuses to fall.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Your weapon attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: You have Advantage on Initiative and on Strength (Athletics) checks. Once per turn, immediately after a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: You gain a second Fighting Style feat of your choice.

features.name: Heroic Warrior
features.description: During combat you can give yourself Heroic Advantage — Advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw — at the start of each of your turns if you have none already.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Your weapon attacks now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18–20.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and at the start of each of your turns in combat you regain HP (5 + your Constitution modifier) if you're below half your HP maximum and have at least 1 HP.

subclasses.name: Battle Master
subclasses.flavor: A student of martial technique who spends Superiority Dice on precise maneuvers — disarming, goading, and outmaneuvering foes.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.description: You learn maneuvers fueled by Superiority Dice (four d8s, regained on a Short or Long Rest). Maneuvers such as Trip Attack, Disarming Attack, Riposte, and Precision Attack let you add a die to a roll and create an effect. The save DC is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier. You learn more maneuvers and gain more dice as you level.

features.name: Student of War
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of Artisan's Tools and in one skill from the Fighter list.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.description: As a Bonus Action you can spend one Superiority Die to study a creature you can see and learn whether it has more or fewer HP than you, plus one other characteristic of your choice.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
features.description: Your Superiority Dice become d10s.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: When you roll Initiative and have no Superiority Dice, you regain one.

features.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
features.description: Your Superiority Dice become d12s.

subclasses.name: Eldritch Knight
subclasses.flavor: A warrior who weaves Wizard magic into swordplay — warding themselves, binding a weapon, and striking with spell and steel at once.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You learn cantrips and a small number of spells from the Wizard list (mostly Abjuration and Evocation), casting with Intelligence. You prepare a growing list and cast using your Fighter level as a one-third caster.

features.name: War Bond
features.description: You can bond with weapons: bonded weapons can't be disarmed while conscious, and you can summon one you can see to your hand as a Bonus Action.

features.name: War Magic
features.description: When you take the Attack action you can replace one attack with casting a cantrip.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon, it has Disadvantage on the next saving throw against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.description: When you use Action Surge you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, before or after the extra action.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.description: When you take the Attack action you can replace one attack with casting a level 1 or 2 spell.

subclasses.name: Psi Warrior
subclasses.flavor: A soldier awakened to psionic power, wielding telekinetic force to shield allies, hurl enemies, and strike from afar.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: You have a pool of Psionic Energy Dice (starting as d6s) that fuel: Protective Field (Reaction to reduce damage to a nearby creature), Psionic Strike (once per turn add Force damage to a hit), and Telekinetic Movement (move an object or creature with your mind). You regain a die on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest; the dice grow larger as you level.

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.description: You gain Psi-Powered Leap (a Bonus Action Fly Speed for one move) and Telekinetic Thrust (Psionic Strike can knock the target Prone or push it 10 feet).

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.description: You have Resistance to Psychic damage, and you can spend a Psionic Energy Die to end the Charmed or Frightened condition on yourself.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.description: As a Bonus Action you can grant yourself and nearby allies Half Cover for 1 minute via telekinetic shields. Once per Long Rest, or by spending a Psionic Energy Die.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.description: You can cast Telekinesis without a spell slot (Intelligence is your spellcasting ability), and while concentrating on it you can still make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.
